Soitec Shares Climb on Guidance, Cash Deposits as Strong AI Demand Boosts Visibility

The stock has more than quadrupled in value since the year began

By

Soitec SOI 12.01 % increase; up pointing triangle shares jumped after the French semiconductor-materials maker issued a stronger-than-expected revenue forecast for the fiscal year and said customers were paying cash deposits to secure its products to build artificial-intelligence infrastructure.

The group said late Wednesday that strong AI demand gave it enough visibility to issue guidance for the fiscal year to the end of March 2027, beyond its usual quarterly projections. Soitec expects revenue to be up around 40% on year at constant currency and scope.
